question: Seven friends, C, D, E, F, G, H and P, are sitting in a row facing north. Only three people sit between F and C. P sits to the immediate left of C. No one sits to the right of E. Only two people sit between E and P. H sits to the immediate right of D. How many people sit between G and H?
solution:
**Given: **Seven friends, C, D, E, F, G, H and P, are sitting in a row facing north.

No one sits to the right of E. Only three people sit between F and C.

P sits to the immediate left of C. Only two people sit between E and P.

H sits to the immediate right of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03ee5734b7f74cd1fee93163ae99d667a0a2a2a6d96e434cc88431a52eac38f9.png] 

Thus, Only two many people sit between G and H.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
